attchmntText: Data Patterns (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Data Patterns India Limited has made available the audio recording of the earnings conference call held on November 09, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. IST. The call discussed the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is accessible on the company website at the provided link. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Prakash R, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 10, 2026.

attchmntText: Data Patterns (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Data Patterns India Limited submitted its investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The company reported net revenue of Rs 1,332 Mn and net profit of Rs 220 Mn for the quarter ended September 2026. Gross margin stood at 69.0 percent and EBITDA margin at 23.6 percent. The order book as of September 30, 2026, was Rs 17,236 Mn. The Chairman and Managing Director stated that fresh orders worth Rs 929 crore were received in Q2FY27. The company acquired a 100 percent stake in ST Advanced Composites Pvt Ltd for Rs 10 crore. The firm expects revenue growth of 20 to 25 percent over the next two to three years.

attchmntText: Data Patterns (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Data Patterns India Limited filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the newspaper advertisement of its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document includes copies of the newspaper advertisements. The announcement was signed by Prakash R, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 07, 2026. The NSE symbol is DATAPATTNS and the BSE company code is 543428. The company's CIN is L25209TN1989PLC017413.
